title: Exquisite Emulsified Syrian Lentil Stew
description: A rich and indulgent Syrian dish featuring brown lentils, this stew is emulsified to create a buttery and juicy texture, making it a perfect ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly meal option.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large binchotan-grill pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the brown lentils, pomegranate molasses, and lemon juice, and stir to combine.
Add 4 cups of water to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes, or until the lentils are tender.
Use an immersion blender to emulsify the stew until it reaches a creamy consistency.
Stir in the butter until melted and well combined.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
